Debugging the intermittent 429 errors from the Anthropic API:
Root cause: our retry logic was using the same API key across all workers.
When one worker hit the rate limit, all workers backed off simultaneously,
then all retried at the same instant — thundering herd.
Fix: added jitter to the exponential backoff (random 0-500ms per retry)
and implemented per-worker rate tracking. 429s dropped from ~5% to <0.1%.

prompts.user:
The ONNX embedding model was leaking memory — RSS grew from 200MB to 1.2GB
over 24 hours. Found that onnxruntime's InferenceSession holds internal caches
that grow unboundedly with varied input lengths.
Workaround: periodic reload of the ONNX session (every 900 seconds or when
RSS exceeds 1.2GB). Added EMBEDDER_AUTO_RELOAD_ENABLED=true config.

support DNS — that's a Docker gotcha.

Post-mortem: Production migration failed because ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN
with a DEFAULT value locks the table in PostgreSQL < 11. We're on PG 10.
The orders table has 50M rows — the lock held for 8 minutes, causing timeouts.
Fix: split into ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN (no default) + UPDATE in batches +
ALTER TABLE SET DEFAULT. Total time: 12 seconds with no locks.
Action item: upgrade to PG 14 where ADD COLUMN DEFAULT is instant.

and configured Cloudflare to pass through CORS headers untouched.
